force.title: The Experience Economy
force.signature: People spend less on owning things and more on doing things — the money moves from the shelf to the ticket, the table, and the night out.

A \u00b7 Going out again: Social venues sell the experience even as drinking itself declines.
Competitive-socializing venues turn an afternoon into a paid experience.
B \u00b7 Days out & escapes: Big-ticket days out keep pricing power as families trade goods for memories.
Cultural and nature attractions ride the shift to meaningful outings.
C \u00b7 The premium night: Boutique stays, casinos, and weddings sell the premium, once-in-a-while experience.
Theaters and live events survive by being an experience streaming can't copy.
E \u00b7 The big picture: Capstone: spending shifts from stuff to experiences; venues and events win, commodity goods lose.
